column1: # foundations-disposition.tsv -- Gap 544-E. DECLARED dispositions for every table in
# repos/foundations.md, so a count can be DERIVED instead of guessed or carried as prose.
# WHY A MANIFEST AND NOT A MARKER IN EVERY ROW: p544 registered 544-E as "mark each row's
# disposition". Measured at p545 the page holds 180 data rows in 31 tables, and NO TABLE
# MIXES DISPOSITIONS -- disposition is a property of the TABLE, not of the row. A per-row
# marker would be 180 edits encoding 31 facts, each one a place to drift.
# WHY KEYED ON HEADING TEXT AND NOT ON A LINE NUMBER: p545's first draft of this manifest
# keyed on line numbers and broke on the very first edit of the page it describes -- the
# header rewrite in the same pass shifted every heading and the gate exited 2. The key is
# therefore the heading's own text, which survives edits above it. Recorded rather than
# quietly fixed, because the failure is the argument for the design.
# DISPOSITION VALUES
#   SHELF   -- load-bearing systems this page files. These, and only these, are counted.
#   CENSUS  -- an enumeration of a population (sampled or exhaustive). Not supply filed here.
#   METRIC  -- a measurement table (counts, rates). Carries no repository rows.
#   SUMMARY -- restates/groups rows filed elsewhere on the page. Counting it double-counts.
# A table present in the page and absent from this manifest is an ERROR, not a default:
# derive-foundations.py exits 2 and names it, so a section added later cannot silently
# re-break the count.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated): heading / table_ordinal / disposition / note
